name: Zro (MoonMath)
description: Coding-focused service with a daily free allowance on two Flash models and zero retention.
overview: Zro is MoonMath's coding-focused inference service, built for agents such as Claude Code and Codex. The Free plan includes a daily allowance on GLM-5.3 Flash and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash that resets every day. The provider states zero request retention and no training on requests.
free_access: Daily free allowance on two Flash models
Zero retention, no training on requests
notes: Allowance size is not published and only the two Flash models are free.
